### Alarmists - One Year Devotions for Men
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/alarmists-one-year-devotions-for-men-december-11.html
Passage: Amos 6:1
Points:
- Society often brushes off godly warnings as mere alarmism, retreating into false comfort.
- Ancient Israel felt untouchable because of wealth, prestige, and religious routine.
- Calamity loomed because the people neglected justice, mistreated the poor, and worshipped self-made idols.
- Taking God's grace for granted while ignoring His holiness inevitably invites judgment.
- True spiritual security comes from taking God's word seriously rather than trusting in self-sufficiency.
